answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 45622 Country: India Title: Seeking way of Dua for goodness of business Question: I beg to inform you that earlier my father used to do some property business which was profitable to some extent. He also had an active role in politics. But sadly from quite some time he does not succeed in anything including his business. Whenever, he does any business he finds it difficult to succeed in it and eventually he loses. He has been experiencing such failures for quite a long time and due to it he has got negative attitude. Even, when I try to do something with his name or in his name, I face the same fate. Whenever, I do something which is not associated with his name, I do not experience any failure generally. I am unable to understand how to get rid of this. You are requested to kindly tell me some dua so that my problem is solved. You also offer dua for us. Please solve the query as soon as possible. Answer ID: 45622 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 909/843/N=1434) Ask your father to recite the following dua and istighfar extensively and you too, in-shaAllah, your business shall prosper. The dua is as follows: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
